description: The tag types in display order. key is stored in tags.type and never localized; label is the German display name; hotkey is the single key that captures the type; tone is the semantic colour alias the chip and marker use (each app maps it to its own theme colours); window is the type's default clip window around a capture point in seconds (start = capture - preS, end = capture + postS), which the team may replace per type (GET /api/tag-windows, see contracts/README.md), so rules take the window as an input rather than looking it up.
